bibl.title: A new kind of loom in early Roman Egypt? How iconography could explain (or not) papyrological evidence.
bibl.seg: Maria Mossakowska-Gaubert, A new kind of loom in early Roman Egypt? How iconography could explain (or not) papyrological evidence.
Maria Mossakowska-Gaubert (ed.), Egyptian textiles and their production: 'word' and 'object' (Hellenistic, Roman and Byzantine periods) = Zea E-Books. 86 (Lincoln, Nebraska, 2020) pp. 13-21, figg.
bibl.note: Looms in ancient Egypt - an overview. - The loom in iconography: missed evidence from Roman Egypt. - Looms in Roman papyrological evidence: an attempt at a new interpretation: Looms (ἱστός, ἱστὸς γερδιακός, ἱστὸς τῶν ἐπικαρσίων, ἐνοίκιος ἱστός); - The weaver's craft (γερδικὴ τέχνη, λινυφικὴ τῶν καθημένων τέχνη). - Final remarks.
